svg.title: All solutions of sin²A + sin²B = sin C in the (A, B) plane
svg.desc: Angle A on the horizontal axis, angle B on the vertical axis, in degrees. The solid blue line A + B = 90° is C = 90°. The dashed orange curves are the other two branches; they lie entirely where A or B is greater than 90°, and the smaller angle never exceeds about 12.8°. Inside the square where A and B are both acute there is only the blue line. Marked points: the two solutions of Problem 1, (15°, 75°) and (75°, 15°), and the counterexample A ≈ 137.6°, B ≈ 12.4°, C = 30°.
